chunks.text: Gobinath Rangaraj is a Senior Software Engineer and AI Product Engineer based in Chennai, India, with 9+ years of experience building and maintaining production web applications. He specializes in Angular and TypeScript, with React and e-commerce experience. He is now focused on AI product engineering: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM agents, and eval-driven development backed by real measurements.
chunks.title: Professional Summary

chunks.text: Gobinath works as a Senior Software Engineer at Crigloo, where he has been since May 2017 - over 9 years. He is the senior frontend owner there: making architecture decisions, maintaining code quality, and mentoring across the UI stack. He is expanding into AI product engineering - RAG pipelines, LLM agents, and retrieval evaluation.
chunks.title: Current Role at Crigloo

chunks.text: Before Crigloo, Gobinath worked as a UI Developer at Netmeds, doing frontend development for a high-traffic Indian e-commerce pharmacy platform.
chunks.title: Netmeds - UI Developer

chunks.text: Earlier in his career, Gobinath worked as a Developer at OREOPS, doing web development across client and product work.
chunks.title: OREOPS - Developer

chunks.text: Gobinath's frontend skills include Angular (his strongest, 9+ years), TypeScript, React, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and Shopify/Liquid for e-commerce storefronts.
chunks.title: Frontend Skills

chunks.text: His AI and data skills include Python, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), LangChain, Sentence Transformers, FAISS vector search, Streamlit, and Generative AI / LLMs.
chunks.title: AI and Data Skills

chunks.text: His engineering skills include Git and GitHub, REST APIs, system design, and building evaluation harnesses for AI retrieval systems.
chunks.title: Engineering Skills

chunks.text: Gobinath built a RAG Document Q&A and retrieval evaluation harness in Python using sentence-transformers and scikit-learn. It compares TF-IDF against SBERT embeddings on the same 13-question set. SBERT reached 100% accuracy versus 75% for TF-IDF, recovering every paraphrase-style question that keyword search missed. Results were measured with winning-margin and abstention calibration.
chunks.title: RAG Evaluation Harness Project

chunks.text: He is currently building a ReAct agent in Python with LangChain - a reasoning-and-acting LLM agent that plans, calls tools, and checks its own work.
chunks.title: ReAct Agent (in progress)

chunks.text: He is also building a Finance Q&A agent using RAG and Streamlit - a document-grounded assistant for personal finance questions that gives cited answers.
chunks.title: Finance Q&A Agent (in progress)

chunks.text: Gobinath earned IBM Generative AI certifications in August 2026.
chunks.title: Certifications

chunks.text: You can contact Gobinath via email at gobigops22@gmail.com, on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/rgobinath, or on GitHub at github.com/gobigobs. His portfolio is at gobigobs.github.io.
chunks.title: Contact

chunks.text: Gobinath is open to senior frontend and AI product engineering roles - remote-from-India, or hybrid in Chennai or Bangalore. His target roles include Senior Frontend Engineer, Senior AI Product Engineer, and AI Product Engineer positions.
chunks.title: Job Preferences
